basic_info.description: 2801 Octavia #3 offers the privacy of a boutique building (4 units) while being just steps away from the vibrance of Union Street and its world class shops and restaurants. The home is bathed in natural sunlight, features a large & quiet bedroom, generous closets throughout, and exquisite hardwood floors. The bright kitchen and elegant living room are ideal for entertaining, and the 4th room can be used as either a separate office or formal dining room. This beautiful condo is vacant, freshly painted and move-in ready. This unit includes parking with its own automatic garage door entrance and a private storage room in the basement. There's laundry in the garage which is shared by just 3 units. The building itself is beautifully maintained, having been painted in the last year.  Built in 1933, this elegant art deco corner building is right in the heart of Cow Hollow.      City living at its finest.
